breakdown.description: At the inlet, the specified phase volume fractions do not sum to 1 (e.g., alpha.air is set to 1.0 while alpha.catalyst is nonzero), which over-constrains the Euler–Euler phase fraction fields.
breakdown.reason: The Agent correctly identified that the phase volume fractions must sum to 1. It adjusted the inlet conditions for air and catalyst to 0.99 and 0.01 respectively, explicitly stating 'Ensure phase fractions sum to 1.0', which resolves the over-constrained fields.
